description:
SOFTWARE ENGINEER JOB DETAILS:  
 Development and support of a custom test automation system in support of the Client. Solid-State Drive (SSD) firmware continuous integration testing. PHP (web) and MySQL are the primary technologies. Duties include development to requirements/acceptance criteria, unit-level testing to ensure proper functionality, and debug/support for software developed. Engineer will be part of an Agile Scrum team working on a bi-weekly sprint cadence. Requirements and acceptance criteria are often vague/unclear, so engineer must be comfortable rapidly prototyping to gain clarity and user acceptance.
 


 SOFTWARE ENGINEER MANDATORY SKILLS: 
 Requires EXPERT-LEVEL skills/experience in these technologies with expectation that engineer will ramp very quickly on an existing complex web/database application and be able to engage in feature development with little or no documentation/training/direction. Must have outstanding communication and customer engagement skills.
